LanguageData.Gun_M40_RWP.description: The M40 is a precision sniper rifle, known for its excellent range and accuracy. Ideal for picking off enemies at a distance, it delivers high-powered shots with deadly precision. Though slow to fire and cumbersome at close range, the M40 is a trusty tool for sharpshooters in engagements where staying distant is the key to survival.
